lines.en: A pitchfork rides on my shoulder.
My boots are caked with camp mud.
I make a circuit along the palisade.
My cloth pouch swings at my hip.
I pause at the well.

lines.zh: 我低头避开低矮的门梁
lines.en: I duck under a low beam.
Someone in the yard calls my name.

lines.zh: 我沿着土路走，避开坑洼。
lines.en: I keep to the dirt road and step around the holes.
My pace is steady, unhurried.
I step around the mud puddle.

lines.zh: 顺手把歪了的木桶扶正
lines.en: I set a tipped barrel upright as I pass.
The light under the roof is dim.
I head toward the cookhouse.
I cross the gravel yard.
I lean on the wall to rest my legs.
I wipe my forehead with a sleeve.
I stand the fork at my feet.

lines.zh: 听院里的人吵着过日子
lines.en: Listening to the yard squabble about daily life.
I count the stones along the wall.
My fingers tap against my knee.
A smith hammers somewhere off.
I cinch my belt a little tighter.
I look up at how the banner hangs.
I chew a stalk of grass.
I sit with my back against a barrel.

lines.zh: 摸了摸口袋里剩的干粮
lines.en: I check the dry rations left in my pocket.
A cat pads past my feet.
I've lived in this camp a long while.
I lift my head and look at you.
You must be new here.
Outsiders wear different boots.

lines.zh: 我把叉子从肩上取下来
lines.en: I take the fork off my shoulder.
Who are you after? I know the ways.
I look you up and down.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道不是本营的
lines.en: You don't smell like this camp.
I'm not looking for a fight.

lines.zh: 你若被俘，我可以领你走
lines.en: If you were taken, I can lead you out.

lines.zh: 我朝院门的方向抬了抬下巴
lines.en: I tip my chin toward the gate.
There's still a place open.
If you stay, you work.
I look at your hands first.
Can those hands still hold a tool?
I smile faintly.
Come in. Don't stand outside.
I recoil, clutching my arm.
You'd strike a citizen?
Someone! Over here!
I gasp twice and straighten.
Blood stains my sleeve.
You don't hit lightly.
I can't hold my fork.
The camp will come looking for you.
I don't want to die here.
I retreat through the door.
Here to trade?
Half a loaf is all I have left.
But I know what's in your hand.
That's exactly what this camp lacks.
I'll find you a bunk.
Eat first. Business after.
I lean the fork against the wall.
Here. Sit down.
This buys a day's work.
I reach out to take it.
Hey. Careful.
I step back and catch my cap.

lines.zh: 你撞得我干草叉都歪了
lines.en: You knocked my fork crooked.
Crowded yard. Squeeze past.

lines.zh: 我撞到你，赶紧让开一条路。
lines.en: I bump you and hurry aside to make way.
No serious harm.
I switch the fork to my other shoulder.
You go your way. I'll go mine.
Nearly stepped on my foot.
In a camp like this, everyone bumps everyone.
There's a woman in this camp waiting for me.

lines.zh: 她的围裙总是洗得很干净
lines.en: Her apron is always scrubbed clean.
I brought her a small pouch of salt.
In the evening we sit by the fire.

lines.zh: 她笑起来，我的活就不累了
lines.en: When she laughs, the work stops aching.

lines.zh: 我们想要一间自己的屋
lines.en: We want a house of our own.
I can raise the walls myself.

lines.zh: 她递水给我，我一口喝完
lines.en: She hands me water and I drain it.
A quiet life beats everything.

lines.zh: 这营要是守住了，就成了
lines.en: If we hold this camp, we're set.
I bend and pick it up.
I wipe it on my sleeve.
This could trade for grain.
I heft it. Not heavy.
Into the pouch at my hip.
I'll hand it to the steward later.
This camp lacks everything.
So we keep everything.
I set it on a crate.
Noted. It'll be useful.
Something's moving outside.
I grab my pitchfork.
The whole camp goes alert.
I glance toward the palisade.

lines.zh: 我停下，盯着你身后的巷口。
lines.en: I stop and stare at the alley mouth behind you.
I shout once to call others.
Someone come help me!
I level the fork's tines forward.
We can't lose this camp.
I stand in the doorway.

lines.zh: 一直盯着你手里的武器
lines.en: My eyes stay on your weapon.
The camp gathers behind me.
I back off one step at a time.
My fork stays level.
We don't want a fight. Don't force one.
I glance at the door behind me.
There are people inside.

lines.zh: 我攥紧拳头，往后退半步。
lines.en: I clench my fists and step back half a pace.
I grip the shaft tighter.
One more step and I'll have to act.
I swing the fork across to block.
I shove the shaft into your chest.
It wasn't very hard.
I shout for the others to back off.
You've grabbed my fork.
I haul it back.
My feet slip.
I bang into a barrel.
The tines are still short of you.
I'm no soldier. Only a citizen.
A man steps out into the camp.

lines.zh: 我从塌了一半的房子里钻出来。
lines.en: I climb out of a half-collapsed house.

lines.zh: 门口有人给我递了个碗
lines.en: Someone hands me a bowl at the door.
A fire is being built in the yard.
I nod toward the cookhouse.
There's still work in this camp.

lines.zh: 我等你把我从这儿救出去。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to get me out.
First, check the water barrel.
I glance up at the banner.
Life still has to go on.
My cuff catches fire and I beat it out.
I land hard and split my knee.
Water fills my mouth and I kick wildly.

lines.zh: 盔甲没穿，气浪就把我掀了。
lines.en: No armor — the blast threw me.
An arrow buries in my shoulder.
I go cold all over and don't know why.
Hunger leaves my hands shaking.
Lightning blacks out my sight.
The ground opens under me.
